svg.title: Stack
svg.desc: Working stack, light theme: Cloudflare Workers, TypeScript, JavaScript, Python, D1, Workers AI, LLM routing. Each label sits on a solid inset panel with a stroke; label contrast computed from hex is 13.55 to 1. Self-hosted in this repository, not a third-party badge service.
